# Dr. Alo's Alo Academy

> A comprehensive cardiology and wellness education platform by Dr. Mohammed Alo offering courses, masterclasses, and personalized coaching on heart health, weight loss, and longevity.

Dr. Alo's Alo Academy combines Dr. Mohammed Alo's expertise as a board-certified cardiologist with modern digital education through the Dr Alo App, online courses, and a VIP community. The platform covers cardiology fundamentals, cholesterol management, GLP1 optimization, weight loss strategies, and heart disease prevention through masterclasses, books, podcasts, and personalized guidance.

## Core Products & Services

- [Dr Alo App](https://dralo.net/app): Free medical education app with heart-healthy courses, masterclasses, and expert cardiology guidance.
- [Alo Academy Store](https://www.dralo.net/store): Main product hub featuring Alo Academy courses, Heart 2 Heart VIP membership, and Dr Alo App access.
- [Heart 2 Heart VIP Community](https://www.dralo.net/resource_redirect/landing_pages/2149083898): Premium membership providing year-round access to Dr. Alo for personalized cardiology guidance and support.
- [Homepage](https://www.dralo.net): Introduction to Dr. Alo and Alo Academy's cardiology and weight loss education mission.

## Masterclasses & Specialized Courses

- [Cholesterol Masterclass](https://www.dralo.net/resource_redirect/landing_pages/2150416487): Advanced course on cholesterol and lipid metabolism with Dr. Alo and expert lipidologists for heart disease prevention.
- [GLP1 Turbo Charged Coaching Course](https://www.dralo.net/resource_redirect/landing_pages/2150425905): Masterclass optimizing GLP1 medications for maximum weight loss and metabolic health results.
- [Weight Loss Masterclass](https://www.dralo.net/weightloss): University-level course covering nutrition science, body recomposition, and evidence-based weight loss strategies.
- [Free Weight Loss Mindset Course](https://www.dralo.net/resource_redirect/landing_pages/2148083898): Foundational free course on weight loss psychology and mindset from Dr. Alo.
- [Cholesterol Masterclass Offer](https://www.dralo.net/resource_redirect/offers/kqmE2XEp): Cholesterol masterclass with Dr. Alo and expert lipidologists for comprehensive lipid education.

## Books & Educational Resources

- [Cholesterol TRUTHS Book](https://dralo.net/cholesterol): Dr. Alo's book on cholesterol myths and truths with endorsements from leading cardiologists.
- [Actual Weight Loss Book](https://www.dralo.net/resource_redirect/landing_pages/2147964877): Science-backed weight loss book by Dr. Alo covering practical strategies and metabolic principles.
- [Heart 2 Heart Heart-Healthy Cookbook](https://www.dralo.net/resource_redirect/landing_pages/2148816866): Recipe collection by Dr. Alo featuring heart-healthy meals designed for weight loss and cardiovascular health.
